text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...More, more, more.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
More, more, more...! At this rate, it 
won't be enough...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: More...!

With the start of the Classic Triple Crown 
route fast approaching, the number of 
reporters visiting the academy to cover 
the event had grown significantly compared 
to before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm not even standing at the starting 
line to contend for the Classic Triple 
Crown yet."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I must seize this chance while my legs can 
still move and push harder... Faster... to 
my absolute top speed...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —*Haa*... *wheeze*...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, the Classic generation is 
incredible~. Just how many laps has 
Yaeno-san run by now, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
That's seriously nuts... If it were me, 
I'd totally puke halfway through that 
menu.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Not even close!! There's no time to be 
complacent!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Both of them are fired up, but...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan won't make it in time, and I 
wonder about Yaeno Muteki... Even the 
undefeated girl who had all that momentum 
ended up losing.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
It's safe to say even her spot in the 
Satsuki Sho is looking precarious. Hmm... 
I wonder who I should pick as the 
favorite.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —"My Favorite, Their Favorite."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No matter how others may judge the two of 
you, my actions will not change.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I believe both of them will come to the 
race in the absolute best condition they 
can manage right now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

Ever since that day she reaffirmed her 
feelings toward the Derby, Sakura Chiyono 
O's gaze had grown sharper and sharper as 
the big day approached.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...One, two... and done. Alright.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, all ready! Come on, let's start 
the training!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Make it a mega-sized portion! A normal 
amount just won't be enough!!

Determined to match her blazing drive, I 
keep a close, watchful eye on her 
training. And then, she takes off running—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, ugh.

As she continued running down the track, I 
thought I saw her form stumble for just a 
split second.
Almost as if she were injured...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ How was that, Trainer? I can still 
keep going!
choice_data_list: Don't tell me... are you hiding an injury?
Don't tell me you're hiding an injury?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Y-Yes... What are you talking 
about...?

She pulled her right leg back, as if 
trying to conceal it from my gaze.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

Sakura Chiyono O's right leg was taped up 
all the way along the calf.

Multiple strips of athletic tape were 
wrapped to pull up the arch of the foot. 
I'd seen that taping technique in a 
textbook before.
choice_data_list:
That's for shin splints, the "beginner's 
ailment," right?

That's for shin splints, the "beginner's 
ailment," right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

Shin splints are a common condition among 
newcomers who suddenly ramp up their 
training volume.

It's particularly common during growth 
spurts before muscle strength has fully 
developed; overusing the legs or 
practicing on hard surfaces causes the 
muscle tendons to become inflamed.
choice_data_list:
Were you hiding and doing extra practice 
on your own?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ugh... You're completely right...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It only hurts for a split second when I 
kick off the ground! It's just an instant, 
so I can totally bear it!
choice_data_list:
If it gets any worse, you won't be able to 
run anymore.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ………… ……I'm sorry.

After asking about the details of her 
pain, fortunately it seems to be minor for 
now. Regardless of taking her to the 
hospital afterward—
choice_data_list:
You'll have to take a break from running 
for a while.

You'll have to take a break from running 
for a while, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
P-Please wait! Not taking time off, 
surely!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
We just saw Yaeno-san's hard work and 
Ardan-san's determination with our own 
eyes! A-And yet...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Giving up on the race over something so 
minor... No. I'd rather risk breaking this 
leg—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
choice_data_list:
Who said anything about giving up on 
racing?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~ Hello there, Trainer! The available 
Japanese-style room is right this way~!

And so, asking for her parents' 
cooperation, we decided to start Sakura 
Chiyono O's rehab at her family home.

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Oh gosh, I'm so sorry for all the trouble 
our Chiyo has caused you~."

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Dad! Daaad! Trainer and the others 
are here~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
U-Uuuu~... Mom, that's enough already! I'm 
already starting my workout in my room!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... Honestly, that girl is just so 
shy.

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer. Thank you so much for going 
out of your way for Chiyo's sake.

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You brought me here because of her 
personality, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Once she sets her mind on something, she 
charges straight ahead. For better or 
worse."

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Even if she got injured herself, she would 
have chosen to push through. Especially 
when there was a girl around she refused 
to lose to.

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text:
So you deliberately set up a place away 
from the Academy—a home environment far 
from racing—to give time to focus on 
rehab. Right?

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text: I truly do nothing but cause you trouble.
choice_data_list:
Still, that single-mindedness is also one 
of their strengths.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Geez! Mom, you're holding Trainer-san up 
way too long! Don't get in their way~!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text:
My! ...Good grief. Well then, Trainer, 
please take good care of that girl.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"So, what were we doing next again? Towel 
gathers, shiko leg stomps, calf 
raises...?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...This feels completely different from 
our usual training, doesn't it?
choice_data_list:
This training includes both treatment and 
prevention.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh~...
choice_data_list:
Of course, we'll have the hospital treat 
you as well, though.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ugh, well, that's true, I suppose...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Still, this time spent is all for winning 
the Satsuki Sho, and by extension, the 
Derby, right?!

And so, we focused on medical treatment at 
the hospital and strength training—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Huff, puff!
(Drag...! Drag...!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... The tatami mats are getting worn 
out. I wonder if Dad's gonna be mad...

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm not mad. After all, that was the 
result of your hard work, Chiyo.

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Chiyo. What kind of girls are you 
running with next time?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...? Um, they're strong girls. They're 
naturally talented, of course, and their 
spirits are tough too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah! But I'm not gonna lose either!! Not a 
chance!!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. In that case, maybe Mom should 
record Chiyo's performance from the TV and 
hand it out to the neighborhood 
association!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~!? That's embarrassing! Just watch me 
properly and that's enough~!

Surrounded by her parents' love, Sakura 
Chiyono O devoted herself to 
rehabilitation and training.
